---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph (Stable Vis View)"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div id="controls" style="display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px;">
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" id="opMode">
    Operator Mode (show isolates)
  </label>

  <input id="filter" placeholder="filter node e.g. GB7FCI" />
</div>

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #222;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>

const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS (truth model)
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ca02c"; // RF
    case "2": return "#ffbf00"; // TELNET
    case "3": return "#1f77b4"; // AXIP
    default:  return "#999";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH (quality)
---------------------------- */
function qualityWidth(q) {
  if (!q) return 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, q / 40));
}

/* ----------------------------
   ACTIVE LINK DETECTION
---------------------------- */
function isActive(e) {
  return e.state === "Active" || (e.quality || 0) >= 250;
}

/* ----------------------------
   BUILD NEIGHBOUR SET FILTER
---------------------------- */
function computeVisible(nodes, edges, filterText, opMode) {

  const f = (filterText || "").toUpperCase();

  const allIds = new Set(nodes.map(n => n.id));

  // operator mode = show everything
  if (!f && opMode) return allIds;

  let match = new Set();

  // direct matches
  nodes.forEach(n => {
    const id = (n.id || "").toUpperCase();
    const alias = (n.alias || "").toUpperCase();

    if (!f || id.includes(f) || alias.includes(f)) {
      if (f) match.add(n.id);
    }
  });

  // if no filter, show all
  if (!f) return allIds;

  // expand to neighbours
  const neighbourEdges = edges.filter(e =>
    match.has(e.source) || match.has(e.target)
  );

  neighbourEdges.forEach(e => {
    match.add(e.source);
    match.add(e.target);
  });

  return match;
}

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD + RENDER
---------------------------- */
async function loadGraph() {

  const res = await fetch(API);
  const data = await res.json();

  const nodeMap = new Map();

  /* nodes */
  (data.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    nodeMap.set(n.id, {
      id: n.id,
      label: `${n.id}\n${n.alias || ""}`,
      alias: n.alias || ""
    });
  });

  /* ensure edge endpoints exist */
  (data.edges || []).forEach(e => {

    if (!nodeMap.has(e.source)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.source, {
        id: e.source,
        label: e.source,
        alias: ""
      });
    }

    if (!nodeMap.has(e.target)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.target, {
        id: e.target,
        label: e.target,
        alias: ""
      });
    }
  });

  const nodes = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  const edges = new vis.DataSet(
    (data.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: e.source,
      to: e.target,
      arrows: "to",
      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",

      width: qualityWidth(e.quality),

      color: {
        color: portColor(e.port),
        highlight: "#ffffff"
      },

      dashes: e.quality === 0,

      shadow: isActive(e),

      font: {
        color: "#222",
        size: 10
      }
    }))
  );

  const container = document.getElementById("network");

  const network = new vis.Network(container, {
    nodes,
    edges
  }, {
    physics: {
      stabilization: true,
      barnesHut: {
        gravitationalConstant: -9000,
        springLength: 140,
        springConstant: 0.04
      }
    },

    interaction: {
      hover: true,
      tooltipDelay: 150
    },

    nodes: {
      shape: "dot",
      size: 12,
      font: {
        color: "#111"
      }
    },

    edges: {
      smooth: {
        type: "dynamic"
      }
    }
  });

  /* ----------------------------
     APPLY FILTER (NEIGHBOUR SAFE)
  ---------------------------- */
  function apply() {

    const filter = document.getElementById("filter").value;
    const opMode = document.getElementById("opMode").checked;

    const visible = computeVisible(
      nodes.get(),
      edges.get(),
      filter,
      opMode
    );

    nodes.forEach(n => {
      nodes.update({
        id: n.id,
        hidden: !visible.has(n.id)
      });
    });

    edges.forEach(e => {
      edges.update({
        id: e.id,
        hidden: !(visible.has(e.from) && visible.has(e.to))
      });
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("filter").addEventListener("input", apply);
  document.getElementById("opMode").addEventListener("change", apply);

}

loadGraph();

</script>
